text: Chapter 9: Recapturing Eldenbaum@Deadly Road to Eldenbaum
■Next Mission\nStart from El Scaro: Temp Palace.
To get to Eldenbaum, first, go to Wazeero Street\nto the east of Tolbas Grassland!
Investigate the traces of the village in Wazeero Street\nabandoned by its inhabitants due to monster attack!
Go to Eryldan Street that leads to Eldenbaum.
Keep going to find out what the monsters inhabiting\nEryldan Street are running away from!
You found out crystal-infested monsters are weak to water!\nUse the magic of water to beat them and go to the next area!
Defeat the crystal monsters that are generating\nthe parasitic monsters to stop their growth and\nlet's move forward!
Defeat the giant crystal monster that is primarily\nresponsible for creating the parasitic monsters and\nis blocking the way to Eldenbaum!
[[N]]Go to the traces of village in Wazeero Street
[[N]]Go to Eryldan Street: Near the Forest of Ein
